title: refinementList issue when upgrading from 0.5.0 to 1 instantsearch.js?
body:
Trying to upgrade instantsearch.js from 0.5.0 to 1 on Algolia shopify app.

I get this error in the console:

```
Uncaught Error: Usage:
refinementList({
  container,
  attributeName,
  [ operator='or' ],
  [ sortBy=['count:desc'] ],
  [ limit=1000 ],
  [ cssClasses.{root,header,body,footer,list,item,active,label,checkbox,count}],
  [ templates.{header,item,footer} ],
  [ transformData ],
  [ autoHideContainer=true ]
})
```

Which seems to be from the refinement-list.js file.

My algolia facets are not current using the .refinementList function (it's whatever came packaged with the most current Algolia shopify app) but I'm guessing that it should? for the facets to work?

Can anyone point me in the right direction?
